skill.name: lead-research-assistant
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through lead research by defining ideal customers, finding matching companies, scoring fit, and planning personalized outreach.
skill.summary: Find and qualify B2B leads with structured account research and outreach planning.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Sales teams lose time turning broad markets into actionable target accounts. This skill structures lead research, fit scoring, and outreach planning for AI assistants.
actual_capabilities: Defines ideal customer profiles from product and market details.
Guides research for target companies by industry, size, location, and need.
Ranks leads with fit scores and clear qualification reasoning.
Suggests decision-maker roles and outreach angles for each account.
Formats results for review, prioritization, and CRM follow-up.
limitations: Requires accurate product details and target market constraints.
Research quality depends on available browsing and data sources.
Public company data can be incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent.
Does not verify private contact details or guarantee sales outcomes.

use_cases.title: Build a Target Account List
use_cases.description: Create a ranked list of companies that match a product, market, and customer profile.

use_cases.title: Plan Partnership Outreach
use_cases.description: Find companies with complementary products and prepare context for partnership conversations.

use_cases.title: Validate a Go-To-Market Segment
use_cases.description: Test whether a market segment contains enough promising accounts before deeper campaign work.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Lead Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a short product description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 qualified leads for my product: [product]. Focus on [industry], [location], and [company size].

prompt_templates.title: Ideal Customer Profile Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you know the best customer profile.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 leads for [product]. Use this ideal customer profile: [industry], [size], [location], [pain points], and [tools used].

prompt_templates.title: Codebase-Based Lead Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository to understand the product. Then identify 10 companies that would benefit from it and explain the fit.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritized Outreach Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for campaign planning after initial research.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized account list for [product]. Include fit scores, target roles, outreach angles, and conversation starters for each lead.

output_examples.input: Find leads for a tool that protects sensitive data in AI coding assistant prompts.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of security-conscious software companies, with fit reasons, target roles, and outreach angles for each account.

output_examples.input: Find Bay Area companies that need remote team productivity consulting.
output_examples.output: A prospect list based on remote hiring signals, likely pain points, priority scores, and suggested conversation starters.

output_examples.input: Analyze this repository and find companies that would use the product.
output_examples.output: A product summary, ideal customer profile, qualified target accounts, and next steps for deeper research.

best_practices: Provide a clear product description, pricing context, and strongest customer pain points.
Set limits for industry, geography, company size, and lead count before research begins.
Review source quality before using any lead in sales outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad lead lists without defining a target customer profile.
Do not treat public data as verified without checking source dates.
Do not send outreach based only on fit scores without human review.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create qualified account lists, fit scores, target roles, and outreach strategies.

faq.question: Can it analyze my codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use repository context to infer the product and suggest likely customer segments.

faq.question: Does it find personal email addresses?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on company research, decision-maker roles, and outreach strategy.

faq.question: Can I use it without web browsing?
faq.answer: Yes, but results will depend on the context and data already available to the assistant.

faq.question: Is this only for software products?
faq.answer: No. It can support services, consulting offers, partnerships, and other B2B products.

faq.question: What should I review before outreach?
faq.answer: Review company fit, source freshness, privacy expectations, and whether the message is accurate.
